stem.text: Two coherent progressive waves from different sources meet at a point.
Which condition **must** be satisfied for there to be zero resultant amplitude at the point where the waves meet?

A.text: The two waves must be emitted from their sources with the same intensity.

B.text: The two waves must be in phase with each other at the point.

C.text: The two waves must be travelling in opposite directions.

D.text: The two waves must have the same amplitude at the point.
